scenes.title: Panique matinale  (Morning Panic)
scenes.summary: Stuck on the Parisian pavement after her nanny abruptly quits, Andrea panics as taxi drivers refuse to take baby Flora without a car seat, jeopardizing her pickup of Hollywood star Sigourney Weaver.

scenes.title: Arrivée à Paris  (Arrival in Paris)
scenes.summary: Stepping in for Andrea at the airport, Camille welcomes Sigourney Weaver, who charms her by speaking fluent French and immediately insisting on a detour to buy delicious Parisian pastries.

scenes.title: Une carte pour Mathias  (A Card for Mathias)
scenes.summary: At the agency, Camille and Gabriel browse get-well cards for Mathias following his heart attack, debating whether sending a card or visiting their former partner in the hospital would feel awkward.

scenes.title: Exigences de star  (A Star's Demands)
scenes.summary: At the Hotel de Crillon, Sigourney Weaver rejects the calm suite recommended for seniors, demanding a bustling room with fitness machines, while Camille tries to reassure her that Andrea will arrive soon.

scenes.title: Vous n'avez pas changé
scenes.summary: Vous n'avez pas changé de bureau, Alex ? Didn't you change offices, Alex? Si... Mais vous êtes déjà venu dans le nouveau. Yes... But you already came to the new ones. Oui, mais... Vous n'avez pas enco...

scenes.title: Tu regardais du porno
scenes.summary: Tu regardais du porno. You were watching porn. Pas du tout. Non, pas du tout. Not at all. No, not at all. Je... Tiens ! Voilà. I was... Here! There you have it. Tu allais te masturber sur Élise. You w...

scenes.title: Sigourney... Qu'est-ce qui se
scenes.summary: Sigourney... Qu'est-ce qui se passe ? Sigourney... What's going on? Ça ne se voit pas ? Je rentre à Los Angeles. Isn't it obvious? I'm going back to Los Angeles. Mais pourquoi ? J'ai dit quelque chose...

scenes.title: C'est pas sa date
scenes.summary: C'est pas sa date de naissance. It's not her birth date. Merde. Dépêche-toi ! Je t'en supplie. Fuck. Hurry up! I'm begging you. Quoi ? What? C'est pas 1-2-3-4 ni 0-0-0-0 ! Il ne me reste qu'un essai. ...

scenes.title: Renvoi de la crèche  (Expelled from Daycare)
scenes.summary: At the daycare center Les Coccinelles, the director furiously confronts Andréa for abandoning baby Flora without warning and expels her, prompting Andréa to walk out defiantly.

scenes.title: Message pour Colette  (A Message for Colette)
scenes.summary: Alone at home, Andréa leaves an affectionate voicemail for Colette asking for news, before receiving a surprise text from rival agent Élise Formain offering full-time childcare.

scenes.title: Répétition amoureuse  (Romantic Rehearsal)
scenes.summary: Sofia helps Gabriel prepare for an upcoming reunion with Sarah by roleplaying the conversation, but her intense questioning reveals that their own romantic history is far from resolved.

scenes.title: Trop de pas  (Too Many Steps)
scenes.summary: Bernard Verley insists on limiting his movie scenes to fifteen steps, but when an energetic Sigourney Weaver demonstrates their new Lindy Hop routine, he panics and flees.

scenes.title: La virée en ville  (The Night Out)
scenes.summary: Sigourney and Arlette realise Bernard will not be joining them for their night out.

scenes.title: Culpabilité  (Guilt)
scenes.summary: Camille feels horribly guilty about Mathias being in the hospital, while playing a board game with her friends.

scenes.title: La fête d'Arlette  (Arlette's Party)
scenes.summary: Andréa pleads with Colette on the phone, before Arlette arrives at the agency with a crowd of partygoers.

scenes.title: Petites coupures  (Small Bills)
scenes.summary: Someone brings a bribe or payment in small bills as requested.

scenes.title: L'aveu d'Hervé  (Hervé's Confession)
scenes.summary: In the agency hallway, Hervé nervously confesses to Gabriel that he played a role in a feature film, only to discover that Élise Formain already leaked his secret to everyone.

scenes.title: La passerelle Debilly  (The Debilly Footbridge)
scenes.summary: Sigourney Weaver strolls along the Debilly footbridge overlooking the Eiffel Tower, admiring the Parisian skyline and stopping to buy a miniature souvenir before her secret rendezvous.

scenes.title: Le couple improbable  (The Improbable Couple)
scenes.summary: Paparazzi spot Sigourney Weaver with Gaspard Ulliel near the Eiffel Tower, while director Guillaume explains to Gabriel that he reversed the film's roles before learning the distributor has pulled out.

scenes.title: Le déjeuner improvisé  (The Impromptu Lunch)
scenes.summary: Sigourney Weaver and Guillaume confront the reluctant distributor at his regular restaurant table, winning over the entire dining room to prove that a romance between an older woman and a younger man is completely credible.

scenes.title: Une théorie du complot  (A Conspiracy Theory)
scenes.summary: Outside ASK, a frantic Gabriel corners Andréa with photographic proof that newly hired agent Élise Formain was secretly meeting StarMédia boss Bréhier on a bridge. Though Andréa initially mocks his paranoia, Gabriel insists Élise is a double agent seeking to sabotage ASK.

scenes.title: Le carnage des talents  (The Talent Carnage)
scenes.summary: Returning to ASK, Andréa and Gabriel are hit with devastating news: phones are ringing off the hook as marquee clients fire them. Checking her inbox, Andréa discovers that Élise Formain has orchestrated a mass defection of ASK's biggest stars to StarMédia, leaving the agency in ruins.

scenes.title: Règlement de comptes  (Settling of Accounts)
scenes.summary: Andréa confronts the traitorous Élise Formain over her ruthless raid on ASK's roster. When Élise dismisses the betrayal as mere business and mocks Andréa's emotional dedication to her clients, a devastated Andréa snaps and lunges at her in fury.

scenes.title: La colère de Noémie  (Noémie's Fury)
scenes.summary: At the hospital following Mathias's coronary attack, producer Igor de Serisy tries to push Mathias immediately back to work. A furious Noémie steps between them to protect Mathias's life, fiercely denouncing Igor's callous cruelty and refusing to let Mathias kill himself for a movie.

scenes.title: Le cœur qui bipe  (The Beeping Heart)
scenes.summary: In his hospital room, Mathias finishes packing his belongings to return home after recovering from his cardiac emergency. Fitted with a medical monitor to track his heart rate, Mathias shares a tender and humorous moment with Camille.

scenes.title: Une nouvelle honnêteté  (A New Honesty)
scenes.summary: Stepping out into the pleasant Parisian afternoon, Mathias and Camille walk side by side away from the hospital. Reflecting on his recent decision to speak openly without deceit, Mathias experiences the strange sensation of total honesty.
scenes.location: Rue de Paris / Sortie de l'hôpital

scenes.title: Vers un nouveau départ  (Toward a New Beginning)
scenes.summary: Under the soft afternoon sun, Camille and Mathias walk quietly along the riverbanks of the Seine. Having left the hospital and agency rivalries behind them, father and daughter take their first peaceful steps together toward a bright future.
scenes.location: Rue de Paris / Quais de Seine
